title: Bhai Taru Singh rejects the Nawab's demand

blocks.text: Bhai Taru Singh enters the Nawab's court with Sikh greetings and immediately provokes anger by refusing to show fear. He questions why he is being harassed when he pays revenue, lives honestly, and shares his earnings in charity.
The dispute sharpens when the Nawab presses him to abandon Sikhi and accept Islam. Would never convert to Islam, Taru Singh insists, because fidelity to the Guru matters more to him than life itself.

The page therefore frames his ordeal not as a political interrogation but as a public test of religious steadfastness. Taru Singh's calm defiance establishes the moral terms for everything that follows.
